exposure: Women with successful trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
difference in dilatation 3 h after admission
Change in cervical dilatation after 3 hours
cohort: 260 women with one previous cesarean who underwent a trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
finding: Two scores, one applied at admission and the other 3 hours later, were developed and showed good performance in predicting the risk of failed TOLAC.
